aboutHeading: 30 Years of Leadlighting in South Kingsville
aboutText: Ageless Leadlights is a family-run stained glass studio in South Kingsville, with over 30 years of experience since 1988. Founded by Michael and Enes, we specialise in lead lighting, copper foil, and mosaics, creating remarkable works for all contexts. Our qualified glass artists are dedicated to teaching and inspiring through our craft. Located at 138 Blackshaws Rd, South Kingsville, we serve the local community with passion and expertise.
servicesSubheading: Stained glass services for every need
servicesText: From custom leadlight windows to mosaic installations, we offer a range of glass art services. Our studio also provides hands-on workshops to teach lead lighting and copper foil techniques. Whether for homes or businesses, we create bespoke pieces that enhance any space.
